messages.subject: Bioc-teaching call May 10, 2-3pm CEST
messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

a quick reminder of the bioc-teaching call on Monday (May 10), now back at the usual time at 2pm CEST. Please add any item that you would like to discuss to the agenda in the google doc <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1s2QMk5XA-uhBVprAO3ZDk1Yfv1cnUWLp9zdvYq9Feu4/edit?usp=sharing>; currently the plan is to review our BioC2021 contributions and discuss the current draft plans for the project and RNA-seq lessons.
Jitsi link: https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching

See you on Monday,
Charlotte & Laurent
